offering_description.value: MSA Safety sells gas and flame detection systems and protective equipment to industrial employers, fire departments and other public agencies. It designs and manufactures the equipment, sells it directly and through distributors, and provides maintenance, training and software for monitoring equipment and worker safety.

primary_products.value: fixed gas and flame detection systems; self-contained breathing apparatus; portable gas detectors; industrial and firefighter helmets; fall protection equipment

primary_services.value: equipment inspection and repair; gas detector calibration; safety equipment training

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas operators, chemical plants, manufacturers, construction contractors, utilities and industrial safety distributors; B2G: Municipal fire departments, public emergency response agencies and military organizations

end_markets.value: fire and emergency services; oil, gas and petrochemicals; industrial manufacturing; construction; utilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: Gas and flame detectors, breathing apparatus, protective equipment, replacement parts and consumables; service fees: Equipment inspection, calibration, repair and training; subscription: Connected safety software and managed portable gas detector programs

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds detectors, breathing apparatus and protective gear from purchased components for industrial employers and fire departments; service provider: Inspects, calibrates and repairs safety equipment for industrial employers and fire departments; software / platform: Uses connected detector data to help industrial employers monitor hazards and manage equipment fleets
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Gas and flame detection, breathing apparatus, helmets, firefighter protective clothing, fall protection and connected safety software

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Industrial safety distributors and specialist fire equipment dealers; direct sales: Company sales teams serving industrial accounts, fire departments and public agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: NIOSH approval for occupational respirators and hazardous-location certification requirements for certain detection equipment
